title: Residential Electricity Supply Early Termination Fee Schedule
content:
The early termination fee terms of each Residential Electricity Supply plan are fixed by this schedule: the method by which the fee is computed, the amounts that method uses, the ceiling, the fee-free window before the contract end date, the waivers the plan grants and the state statutory ceilings.

## Fee method and amounts

| Plan | Method | Fee per remaining month (USD) | Flat fee (USD) | Ceiling before any state cap (USD) | Fee-free window before contract end (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | none | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | flat | 0.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 14 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | per remaining month | 10.00 | 0.00 | 120.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | per remaining month | 10.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | per remaining month | 15.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | flat | 0.00 | 99.00 | 99.00 | 30 |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | per remaining month | 8.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 45 |

Under the "none" method no fee is charged. Under the "flat" method the flat fee is charged. Under the "per remaining month" method the fee per remaining month is charged for each remaining month of the term. The fee-free window is the number of calendar days immediately before the contract end date during which a cancellation carries no early termination fee.

## Waivers granted by each plan

| Plan | Waived when the utility final-billed the premise for a move-out | Waived for a customer enrolled in a utility customer assistance program | No fee on a mid-term move to a Beacon Ridge plan with an equal or longer term |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | yes | yes | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | yes | yes | yes |

## State statutory ceilings

Residential early termination fees are subject to a per-state statutory ceiling on every plan. The only state with a ceiling is Illinois (IL), where the ceiling is 50.00 USD; Pennsylvania, Ohio, New Jersey and Maryland impose no cap.
